witnesses.title: producer provenance and cached/live status component check
witnesses.code:
from dataclasses import dataclass

@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Run:
    run_id: str
    runtime_id: str
    code_hash: str
    input_hash: str
    env_hash: str
    output: bytes
    success: bool

@dataclass
class View:
    status: str
    provenance: str
    label: str

def assess(run, current_code, current_input, current_env, runtime_id):
    if run is None:
        return View("unverified", "unknown", "No producing event")
    if not run.success:
        status = "failed" if (run.code_hash, run.input_hash, run.env_hash) == (current_code, current_input, current_env) else "stale"
    elif (run.code_hash, run.input_hash, run.env_hash) != (current_code, current_input, current_env):
        status = "stale"
    else:
        status = "current"
    provenance = "live" if run.runtime_id == runtime_id else "cached"
    return View(status, provenance, f"run={run.run_id}; runtime={run.runtime_id}; env={run.env_hash}")

saved_error = Run("r-1", "kernel-old", "code-a", "data-a", "env-old", b"ModuleNotFoundError", False)
view = assess(saved_error, "code-a", "data-a", "env-new", "kernel-new")
assert view.status == "stale"
assert view.provenance == "cached"
assert "run=r-1" in view.label and "runtime=kernel-old" in view.label

success = Run("r-2", "kernel-new", "code-a", "data-a", "env-new", b"result", True)
view2 = assess(success, "code-a", "data-a", "env-new", "kernel-new")
assert (view2.status, view2.provenance) == ("current", "live")
reopened = assess(success, "code-a", "data-a", "env-new", "kernel-after-reopen")
assert (reopened.status, reopened.provenance) == ("current", "cached")
missing = assess(None, "code-a", "data-a", "env-new", "kernel-new")
assert missing.status == "unverified"
print("stale saved error distinguished from live output; matching event marked current with cached/live provenance; missing event unverified")
witnesses.expected_behavior_justification: the bounded check exercises the corrected contract: an old error whose environment differs is stale and visibly cached with producer IDs; a matching successful event remains marked cached after reopen; an absent event is unverified
witnesses.stdout: stale saved error distinguished from live output; matching event marked current with cached/live provenance; missing event unverified
